rationale: No Playwright spec covers the AI Observability Queue Workbench item navigator. The only in-diff tests are Vitest unit specs (QueueWorkbenchPage.nav.spec.ts, llm-queues.service.spec.ts, systemProvidedVariables.spec.ts), which mock the service layer and provide no E2E coverage of the real rendered DOM. model-pricing.spec.js is the sole enterprise-LLM spec in GeneralTests but tests a different feature (model pricing). The new input-preview behavior is a distinct area and its own spec; it must be registered under the GeneralTests run_files (ENT overlay home, alongside model-pricing) because no AIObservability shard exists in the base ci_matrix.json.
